articles.image_title: June 29, 2017 - Munich - Anti-racism and anti-discrimination activist and member of the migrationsbeirat Hamado Dipama. 15 citizens and members of the Netzwerk Rassismus- und Diskriminierungsfrei Bayern eV demonstrated at MunichÃ¢â¬â¢s Hauptbahnhof against the latest case of misconduct by Deutsche Bahn Security, which was filmed by a journalist on an S8 S-Bahn train. Journalist Natalija Miletic filmed the incident and is heard saying Ã¢â¬ÅracismÃ¢â¬Â, alleging that the processes the personnel used created an escalation and were violations of their policies and went into areas only the police are allowed to handle...In the latest case of a string of verbal and physical abuse allegations, as well as racial profiling and insults against Deutsche Bahn security personnel, a violent escalation was filmed and posted by journalist Natalija Miletic, where racism and irregularities in the fine processing were alleged and a dangerous chokehold was instituted against a Nigerian passenger, well past the time limit before brain injury occurs. Such chokeholds, or ''carotid holds'' have been banned around the world due to the danger of irreversible brain injury after only seconds of application. Deutsche Bahn has condemned the escalation of violence, while critics claim this to be part of the working culture of security employees. The case is under investigation by the Bundespolizei against the Deutsche Bahn employees, as well as the victim. ..The victim had no ticket, as verified by the Deutsche Bahn security personnel, but, according to the account, they made the process difficult, including having confiscated the last 9 Euros the man had and then imposing the fine of 60 EUR. It is unknown if they documented the confiscation. ..Heavy, ongoing criticism is being thrown at Deutsche Bahn's inconsistently-applied policies of removing so-called ''Schwarzfahrer'' from trains, as they increase the risk of escalations...

articles.title: Tochter findet Leichen im Wohnhaus ihrer Mutter – Spur führt zu zwei Männern
articles.teaser: In Rinteln hat eine 22-Jährige eine furchtbare Entdeckung gemacht, als sie am Morgen das Haus ihrer Mutter und deren Lebensgefährten aufsuchte. Kurz darauf nahm die Polizei zwei Männer fest.
